About Me

I design websites and brand identities for small businesses that want to look premium without a photoshoot. From logos, packaging and festive posters to storefronts with their own owner console, I keep every layout clean, fast and mobile-first, so a brand can connect, communicate and convert.

Storefronts and portfolios

Brandings

BRANDINGS.

Yarn + Craft = YB Craft

YB Craft is a handmade table-mat and home décor brand. A small yarn-ball mark and the line “Handmade with Love” carry the identity across kraft gift boxes, cotton pouches, tags, thank-you cards, stickers and business cards. Warm cream, kraft brown, sage green and chocolate keep everything modern, sustainable and clearly artisan-made.

LogoPackagingStationeryBrand guide
Websites

WEBSITE DESIGN.

GippyeS Studio

GippyeS Studio sells handmade pipe-cleaner art. The storefront pairs a dark theme with elegant serif type for a premium, artisan feel. Checkout is a single step with a direct WhatsApp field and a high-contrast “Pay & Order” button, and a passcode-protected owner console lets the brand add, edit or remove products in seconds.

Home pageBag & checkoutOwner console
Posters

FESTIVE POSTERS.

Bappa and Maa Bappa

Two festive posters built around bold, hand-set Devanagari lettering. Cracked white texture on deep red frames a black-and-white idol, and the only colour that breaks the grayscale is red: flowers, a trident and the background itself. The eye goes straight from the word to the deity.

TypographyPhoto manipulationFestive
Posts

SOCIAL MEDIA POSTS.

Connect. Communicate. Convert.

A step-by-step carousel that shows small businesses how to prompt their way to a complete brand: logo first, then packaging, then offline branding like business cards. Every slide uses the same warm texture, serif headlines and one clear instruction, so it reads in seconds and is easy to save.
